embeds.title: 🔴 FBI Warns of Silent Ransom Group Using In-Person IT Support Impersonation to Target US Law Firms
embeds.description:
**Actor:** The Silent Ransom Group (SRG)
The FBI reports that The Silent Ransom Group (also known as Luna Moth, Chatty Spider, and UNC3753) has been targeting US-based law firms with a new tactic since spring 2026: posing as IT support personnel to gain physical access to computers and insert malware or steal data via USB devices. The group has historically conducted data theft and extortion operations since at least 2022, but has recently shifted from phishing-based remote access tactics to in-person social engineering attacks.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🟡 2 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Social engineering via impersonation of IT support personnel, followed by physical access to insert USB storage devices
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://www.csoonline.com/article/4177864/employees-are-unknowingly-inviting-tech-support-impersonators-into-firms-says-fbi.html)
